children: RNS Number : 6731U  Thrive Homes Finance PLC  14 September 2026
Announcement of the Filing of Thrive Homes Limited Group Accounts for the year ended 31 March 2026

Thrive Homes Finance plc announces that the Group Report and Financial Statements of its parent company, Thrive Homes Limited, for the year ended 31 March 2026, are available to view online. The Statements are expected to be filed with the Regulator in due course.
The Statutory Accounts are available on Thrive Homes Limited website; https://www.thrivehomes.org.uk/our-performance
